fr.elements: Main Residence; Landscaped Area; Access Drive; Open Green Space; Open Terrain
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Open Terrain; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with vertical reflective posts on both sides to guide responders during low-visibility or nighttime response.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of parked vehicles and equipment so responders can reach the residence without stopping to reposition.
• Maintain driveway width and overhead clearance along the entire drive to allow fire apparatus and ambulances to pass without obstruction.
• Identify and mark a turnaround point near the residence so apparatus can reposition without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Clear a staging area near the residence that responders can use to park and work without blocking the driveway.
• Keep gates along the driveway unlocked or equipped with a Knox-Box or standard breakaway lock so responders are not delayed at entry.
• Trim landscaping along the driveway that narrows the travel path or reduces driver sightlines.
• Mark any secondary foot path or route around the rear of the residence so responders can orient quickly on arrival.
• Post a site map or address placard near the driveway entrance showing the residence location and any secondary access routes across the open terrain.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Terrain; Scattered Trees; Long Driveway; Ground Vegetation; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Shrubs; Single Access Route
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly against or within a few feet of the house walls.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure to increase open space between tree canopies and the roofline.
• Remove ground vegetation growing close to the base of the house on all sides.
• Keep low-growing shrubs along the driveway cut back so vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Trim any tree branches that hang over the driveway to maintain clear vehicle access along the full length.
• Thin shrubs and ground cover along the driveway edges to keep the single access route visible and passable for large vehicles.
• Separate shrub clusters near the structure so there are clear gaps between individual plants and the house.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from shrubs growing near any outbuildings or attached structures on the property.
